scope: Only four existing tracked mobile files; Android embedded public/iald.js is generated/ignored and not force-added. Web app/iald.js is outside private mobile repo.
preconditions: Main installs accepted plan; frontend SHA717b remains frozen.
Fresh deploy preflight matching current revision/lease; source authorization receipt verified without identity claim.
Exact existing private origin and push origin, exact branch, baseline HEAD, clean index and only allowlisted tracked changes.
Git staged blobs must equal exact installed SHA256; filters transforming bytes refuse before commit.
Push performs live branch-head check, no force, and post-push verification. A missing push receipt stays uncertain; no automatic retry.
Commit and push are distinct flags/receipts; no build/store availability inferred from push.
risk: Push may trigger the existing configured Xcode Cloud workflow; this source authorization is recorded, but execution waits coordinator review and installation.
